I founded Coach Academy to multiply the impact of evidence-based coaching in the world. I earned an MA in Psychology from Harvard to learn from the best in the field. And I built Coach Academy to pay it forward, and to set the highest standards.

Kelly Wood is a strengths-based life design coach and facilitator. She creates experiences that build awareness, spark momentum, and help people move forward. Her clients include Mount Royal University, University of Alberta, SoulFood, Campus Alberta Neuroscience, Ghost River Theatre, and Whitehorse’s Heart of Riverdale Community Centre. She has taught at Banff Centre for Arts and Creativity’s Leadership Institute.
